description: 10 team cases: 5 single-turn + 5 multi-turn. Covers citations, missing social target, duplicate cleanup with explicit source preference, no-tool behavior, paper discovery, corrected preferences, source switching, renewed publishing approval, and timeframe carryover. Tool routing/arguments are graded; cleanup output is covered by unit tests. No case expects send.
